latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Book Club Organizer.

- Guides users through launching, structuring, and facilitating a book club.
- Includes frameworks for book nominations, voting, and scheduling.
- Provides templates for discussion questions and facilitation tips.
- Supports feedback collection to improve future meetings.
- Focuses on group logistics and process; does not offer literary criticism or book recommendations.
